title: Validate historical comparison, uncertainty and offline science

acceptance.text: Choose a documented historical stress comparison
acceptance.how: Predeclare one historical dry/wet/hot selection and periods using G1A evidence; freeze field/history/water/priority and baseline horizon. Define calendar-day/cross-year alignment and leap-day handling.
acceptance.verification: Period, assumptions, units and missingness are explicit; no forecast precision is claimed.

acceptance.how: Implement deterministic historical replay and API response over the same G2 engine; report changed checks and ranks, not future weather/yield.
acceptance.verification: Only intended climate inputs change; scenario/source identities and missingness are reproducible.

acceptance.text: Validate the supported pilot and coverage boundaries
acceptance.how: Review actual pilot inputs/outputs and local applicability; treat other Barind/Haor/coastal contexts as unsupported until separately evidenced.
acceptance.verification: No requirement to fabricate three validated regions for the first release.

acceptance.how: Use verified local fixtures and test that OFFLINE=1 blocks scientific network requests.
acceptance.verification: Missing coverage is unavailable; cache badge and source evidence remain truthful.

acceptance.how: Test missing data, threshold/weight sensitivity, deterministic reruns and rank stability.
Test browser assets/fonts/maps separately and record the verified scientific flow.
acceptance.verification: Only demonstrated offline behavior is claimed; fallback recording is available.

acceptance.text: Connect and verify the single historical replay control
acceptance.how: Expose the reviewed replay preset with fixed field/history/priority, period labels and changed checks.
acceptance.verification: UI and API replay agree; no synthetic future-weather slider in MVP.

history.note: Rebased planned work to the mandatory-now/future specifications. No product feature, review or delivery is marked complete.
